reviews.rationale: The regex captures every character before the first semicolon or comma in a data URI. Base64Editor.refreshPreview interpolates that capture into preview.innerHTML, so markup-shaped capture text can alter the parsed DOM in an exact local helper model. The frozen source does not define whether initial editor values may come from an untrusted party or state a separate requirement for safe rendering of malformed MIME metadata. Keep the sink behavior unresolved; do not call it an adopted product contract or count a product question.

reviews.rationale: This is the source anchor for one composite EnumEditor string-rendering question. The editor precomputes HTML for schema enum values and later assigns the cached value to display_area.innerHTML. The string branch applies ampersand, less-than, then greater-than replacements so string leaves are rendered as text. The single contract and gate cover this ordered three-regex chain; the adjacent stages are not counted as duplicate questions. Object keys and other value types are outside this claim. The input is application schema configuration, and the question does not claim untrusted schemas or downstream impact.
